# Geeker-Admin selective reuse

Source: https://github.com/HalseySpicy/Geeker-Admin

Revision: `ad08fdd1c08bfd2390a85fbbb359be17e2bdaae9`

License: [MIT](LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2022 Halsey.

Selected original dataScreen layout source and stylesheet are retained under `src/views/dataScreen/`. The current application layout was subsequently redesigned; unused copies of the header and section-title assets were removed from the application. Upstream reference assets remain here with their license. The original tourism charts, data, map and dependencies are not imported. Application business charts, operational controls, official map integration and responsive layout are adapted for Helian.
